Logo jest punktem startowym, ale nie pow: The logo is the starting point, but it shouldn't stay alone. The mark alone won't build the full impression of the brand if the rest of the communication is random. That's why a good logo should be supported by a visual identity, i.e. the rules for using it and elements that develop its character.

Jak przenieść branding na stronę interne: How to carry branding over to the website so the brand is really felt?
Strona internetowa jest jednym z najważn: The website is one of the most important places where branding becomes a real experience. This is where users not only see the logo, but start to feel the brand's style through the layout of the content, the behavior of buttons, the typography, the way the offer is presented and the overall feel of the interface.
Branding na stronie nie polega na wkleje: Branding on a website isn't about pasting the logotype in the top left corner. The brand should be present in the headings, hero sections, offer cards, forms, icons, CTAs, animations and details.
Nagłówek, lead, zdjęcie i CTA powinny od: The heading, lead, photo and CTA should immediately communicate the brand's character.
Przyciski, karty, formularze i sekcje po: Buttons, cards, forms and sections should use one visual language.
Marka powinna zachowywać jakość i spójno: The brand should keep its quality and consistency on the phone too, not just on desktop.
Dobrze działają strony budowane na powta: Websites built on a repeatable visual language work well: the same rhythm of spacing, the same button styles, a similar section structure, a consistent use of colors, photos and CTAs. As a result, users don't just look at the brand, they immerse themselves in it naturally.
